# Brainstorming Skill for Muse

Turns a fuzzy idea into a solid design or spec through a structured collaborative dialogue: it works to understand the intent and context, sharpens the idea with you, presents a design, and only moves forward once you — the human partner — approve it. Meant to run before any creative work, from a new feature to a behavior change. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the source text is written in an imperative tone ("You MUST use this") that you can simply ignore; the underlying methodology is generic but genuinely solid, and it works just as well as a plain prompt.
